mechanism_narrative: A decline in the federal funds rate over the past month signals an accommodative monetary policy stance that reduces equity discount rates, driving positive S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: S&P 500 20-day returns are negative in more than 60% of months when FEDFUNDS declines, or the Rank IC over 3 years is below 0.03.

mechanism_narrative: When the unemployment rate falls below 4.5% for two consecutive months, it indicates a tight labor market that boosts consumer spending and corporate earnings, leading to positive S&P 500 returns over the next 20 days.
failure_condition: S&P 500 20-day returns are negative in more than 50% of instances when UNRATE is below 4.5% for two months.

mechanism_narrative: Simultaneous growth in retail sales and declining interest rates signal strong consumer demand and accommodative monetary policy, which together drive positive equity returns over the next 20 days.
failure_condition: The interaction between RSAFS growth and FEDFUNDS decline fails to predict positive returns when both conditions are met, with Rank IC < 0.03 over 3 years.

mechanism_narrative: In high inflation regimes (CPIAUCSL YoY > 2.5%), a rise in the federal funds rate above 5.0% triggers a sell-off in equities as real rates increase, causing negative S&P 500 returns over the next 20 days.
failure_condition: S&P 500 20-day returns are positive in more than 50% of instances when CPIAUCSL YoY > 2.5% and FEDFUNDS > 5.0%.

mechanism_narrative: Strong retail sales growth (RSAFS) indicates robust consumer spending, which supports corporate earnings and drives positive S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: S&P 500 20-day returns are negative in more than 60% of months when RSAFS grows, or the Rank IC over 3 years is below 0.03.

mechanism_narrative: When industrial production (INDPRO) falls below 110 for two consecutive months, it signals a weakening manufacturing sector that reduces corporate profits, leading to negative S&P 500 returns over the next 5 days.
failure_condition: S&P 500 5-day returns are positive in more than 50% of instances when INDPRO < 110 for two months.

mechanism_narrative: In high industrial production growth regimes (INDPRO > 115), a decline in manufacturing output relative to the prior month signals an early recession, causing negative S&P 500 returns over the next 20 days.
failure_condition: S&P 500 20-day returns are positive in more than 50% of instances when INDPRO > 115 and INDPRO declines from the prior month.

mechanism_narrative: Strong housing starts (HOUST) indicate a robust construction sector and consumer confidence, which drive positive S&P 500 returns over the next 60 trading days as the economy expands.
failure_condition: S&P 500 60-day returns are negative in more than 60% of months when HOUST is above 1400, or the Rank IC over 3 years is below 0.03.
